featured_reviews.name: Jeraj Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's been already one year since we have shifted to the house made by Home Decor,

I would never thought I might have to write a review to make these people realise what kind of professionalism they have showed by accepting this project.

In the initial phase all the follow up and deadlines were reached right on the stop but the real phase started when we delayed a payment for few days for which they completed stop the work and when the payment was made we never saw same manpower and same rhythm which we saw before.

These guys used to really cut short on the manpower which might save their money, but upon making a personal request to increase manpower still it NEVER EVER happened.

Mr. Shubham who handled our project never said NO for any work but always did the work as the way he wanted in the pace he wanted.. He was always concerned about the payment but never thought of the development of the work and was never even seen on the site to check the status of the work.

The basic estimates were giving by Mr. Shubham were so convincing that ANYONE could fall for it but later we realised the estimates were provided for the product which someone will NEVER ACCEPT in their house and ends up buying decent products which technically you will end up paying more..
Mr. Jay was handled the project as a site contractor..
His role was the keep a site under control with day to day requirment for which he was least bothered as he was following the SPECIAL instructions from Mr. Shubham and the result was WORK AT THE SITE WAS TAKING ALL ITS TIME..

We completely understand Payment was done as per milestone achieved but if any delays were caused in the same would result in delays which were completely not accepted and out of our expectations, even after the payment were done, we had to keep a strong follow up to get the work set back on track. LIKE HAVE TO BEG FOR IT !!

Ms Kesar was our Interior designer from their team, she was so decided and enthusiastic for her work that once the project was completely she didn't even bother to check the site or show a visit to see how things have settled up post completion of the project, she was completely clueless with her designs as she was planning to Paint whole house in White colour and all white interior even though we had asked for a colourful combinations, she was clueless on space saving concept which might have resulted our living room to look absolutely conjugated, BUT LUCKILY WE DIDN'T LET THAT HAPPENED, At the end majority of the colour combination and space saving concept come out of our side rather then she showing her expertise..

Mr. Yadava who is owner of this company was clueless during the meeting which was held for the selection of laminates, he was least bothered to know the budget and ended up wasting time by more than and hour by showing most expensive laminates..

After the completion of the project as promised for the Deep cleaning with so much of technicalities explained for the same the output was phtetic for the proof I have attached some pictures with this review, so have to asked them to get the cleaning done again..

Once the project is handled over this guys were least bothered to know the difficulties we faced as they were just intrested and focused on the photoshoot to show world how superior they are..

Till date I still haven't got my pending works done as they wanted to get the photoshoot of the project.

Finally we decided to post a review and share the experience around so that people around take a wise decision to interact with them..

I wished someone could had shared their REAL experience to us before we handed our project to them....

I have attached few pictures in which you the quality of the work is observed.
-They way paint is getting pealed off.
-The way ceiling wallpaper getting damaged even after changing it with the previous worst fitting.
- False ceiling work has already developed major cracks.

Pictures says it all !!

POP vs Gypsum for False Ceiling Design: Which is Better for Indian Homes?

Need a false ceiling for your home but wondering whether to choose POP or Gypsum? Well, that’s a pretty common concern amongst homeowners. Let’s take a look at what Livspace’s best interior designers in Mumbai recommend for Indian homes:

POP (Plaster of Paris) is custom-made on-site, can be crafted to create intricate details and designs, and fits perfectly for decorative lighting. POP offers a premium and luxurious look, making it ideal for bigger homes and villas. Although installing it can be a time-consuming and messy process.

Gypsum, the ready-made boards, on the other hand, offer a hassle-free and quick installation while creating a smooth and seamless finish. It’s ideal for modern homes where minimalism and easy maintenance are priorities. Gypsum is durable, offers fire-resistance benefits, and is also lightweight, making it the best choice for apartments and small homes.

The final answer is - for big homes where customization and a premium look are concerns, opt for POP, and for modern compact homes where quick installation is required, go for Gypsum.

Still concerned about the right false ceiling design in Mumbai? Visit Livspace - Interior Design Studio, Borivali, and talk to the best interior designers in Mumbai will curate the perfect plan for you.

Hinged Wardrobe vs Sliding Door Wardrobe Designs in Mumbai - Which is the Better Choice?

Both wardrobe designs are trendy and equally functional, but offer different benefits. Here’s what Livspace’s best interior designers in Livspace - Interior Design Studio, Borivali advise based on your requirements⬇️

✍🏼Hinged wardrobes are best for storing bulky items such as heavy blankets, large pillows, and suitcases. These items take up a lot of space, so a hinged wardrobe comes in handy, as the door opens outward, offering full visibility.
Whereas sliding door wardrobes are practical for storing outfits, bags, shoes, and other day-to-day essentials. Smaller items ensure the wardrobe door slides smoothly without anything getting stuck in between.

✍🏼 Hinged wardrobes are ideal if the room has ample space to swing open the doors without causing any space restraints.
Sliding wardrobes are perfect for compact rooms, as the doors slide sideways, they do not occupy any extra space in the room.

✍🏼Hinged wardrobes work well for the kids' bedroom, as for a child, opening and closing the doors remains easy and hassle-free. Sliding wardrobes are a good match for households with pets, as they can not easily slip inside and get stuck accidentally.

How to choose the right curtains for your living room in Mumbai?

What’s that one element in interior design and home decor that’s crucial but often gets overlooked? Curtains! The subtle power of the flowy pieces of fabric is an art in itself, especially when it comes to aesthetic living room designs.

If a living room is adjacent to an open balcony, then floor-length sheer curtains with delicate embroidery work p beautifully with another pair of heavy curtains. The sheer fabric filters harsh sunlight during the day, while the heavier one blocks unwanted light at night, offering ample privacy.

For a living room with big windows, opt for sill-length neutral or pastel colored curtains. Add window chimes and ornaments for extra flair.

Curtain rods play a huge role too. It’s best to hang it higher and wider than the window or balcony door frame, as it allows for opening up the space by creating an illusion of a higher ceiling and bigger windows.

How to choose the best modular kitchen layout for a small apartment in Mumbai?

🧑🏼‍🍳For a studio home, a straight kitchen is the best choice - minimalist, functional, and covers a single wall, so the space doesn’t feel cramped.

👨🏼‍🍳A L-shaped kitchen is a popular choice for small apartments, as it utilizes the corner space strategically. This modular kitchen layout is compact, offering plenty of storage while leaving enough space to move around freely.

👩🏼‍🍳 A U-shaped kitchen is the ideal choice for a small to medium space, as it covers three walls. This layout provides ample storage for all your cooking appliances while still leaving a generous counter space for easy cooking.

featured_reviews.name: Agniv Banerjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are extremely delighted with the interiors delivered by Bhartik Interiors. From planning to execution, the entire process was smooth, well-organized, and truly impressive. The designs were thoughtfully created, blending modern aesthetics with everyday practicality, resulting in a home that feels both elegant and comfortable.

The proprietor has exceptional design sense and a clear vision. He carefully understood our expectations and transformed them into beautifully crafted spaces. Every detail — from layout planning to finishes and lighting — was handled with great precision and creativity.

What makes Bhartik Interiors stand out is not just their quality of work but also their values. The proprietor is a person who believes in long-term relationships rather than quick business. His honesty, dedication, and professionalism were evident throughout the project. He kept his commitments and ensured timely completion without compromising on workmanship.

The team was cooperative, skilled, and responsive to every small request. The final outcome exceeded our expectations and gave our house a warm, luxurious, and welcoming feel.

For anyone seeking stylish interiors with reliability, affordability, and a personal touch, Bhartik Interiors is a wonderful choice. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: dhwani sondkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Bhartik interiors, and I couldn't be happier with the results. From our very first meeting, they truly understood my vision and brought it to life in ways I hadn’t even imagined. Their eye for detail, color coordination, and space planning is simply exceptional.
They were professional, communicative, and extremely creative throughout the entire process. Every room now feels both functional and beautiful, with a perfect balance of style and comfort. They also stayed within budget and completed everything on time—something that's rare and very much appreciated.
I’ve received countless compliments from friends and family, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Bhartik interiors to anyone looking to transform their space. Truly top-notch service and talent!

featured_reviews.name: GEETA BHUL
featured_reviews.review_text: Overall, I feel let down by the entire experience. When you are paying a premium price, you expect professionalism, transparency, and quality work—but unfortunately, that wasn’t my experience here. I would strongly recommend that others clearly document all details, including materials and expectations, before starting any work, and consider comparing with other options before making a final decision.”

featured_reviews.review_text: “Excellent service and very professional team. They understood my requirements perfectly and delivered exactly what I wanted. The design, quality of work, and finishing are outstanding. Highly recommended for anyone looking for interior design services.”

featured_reviews.name: Sonu Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Bhartik Interiors, and I am truly impressed with the transformation they brought to my home. The interior design they created is absolutely amazing—stylish, modern, and perfectly tailored to my taste. Every room feels more beautiful, comfortable, and well-planned than I ever imagined. Their attention to detail and creative vision clearly shine through in every corner of the house.
What impressed me just as much as the design itself was their professionalism. Bhartik Interiors delivered everything on time, exactly as promised. Their team was punctual, organized, and incredibly easy to communicate with. They listened carefully to my ideas and blended them seamlessly with their own expertise to create a stunning final result.
The entire experience was smooth, stress-free, and highly satisfying. The quality of work, dedication to customer satisfaction, and overall service were truly exceptional. I am extremely happy with the outcome and would highly recommend Bhartik Interiors to anyone looking for top-notch interior design and reliable service. A fantastic experience from start to finish!

featured_reviews.name: Akshat Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got my home interiors done by Bhartik Interiors in Mira Road, and I must say it was one of the best decisions I have ever made. From the very first meeting, their team was extremely professional, friendly, and patient in understanding exactly what I wanted. Bhartik Sir himself was very friendly and humble, which made the whole experience even better. He personally guided me through the design process, helping me choose the best materials, colors, and layouts for my home.

The quality of their work is absolutely top-notch! The sofa set they made for me is super comfortable and stylish, and the TV unit has completely transformed the look of my living room. Every single piece of furniture they delivered feels premium and is crafted with care. The finishing is so perfect that it feels like living in a luxury apartment.

Thanks to Bhartik Interiors, my house truly feels like a palace now! Friends and relatives who visit can’t stop complimenting how elegant and beautiful everything looks. I am extremely happy and satisfied with their work and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for high-quality interiors, furniture, and excellent service. If you want to turn your house into a dream home, Bhartik Interiors – with Bhartik Sir’s personal touch – is the best place to go!
